entries.location: Potion chamber — bottle selection and passage
entries.description: The riddle specifies three poisons, two nettle wines and two passage-enabling drinks; wine has poison on its left side as worded, end bottles differ, neither end leads onward, smallest/largest are safe, and second from each end taste alike. entries.model_notes: Positions of smallest and largest within the line are not numbered in the prose; do not invent them. The smallest bottle has only one swallow left. The riddle’s left-side statement should be preserved as a puzzle constraint, not a complete bottle map.
